approaches.description: linux/riscv64 defaults to and only allows grub-efi; qemu riscv64 uses virt machine, -cpu rv64 under TCG, firmware passed via WithBios attached as readonly pflash unit 0 (code only, no vars needed).
approaches.evidence: e2e ubuntu:24.04 PASS 523s (log c06d43cc...), debian:13 PASS 1013s (log d5b2e436...): single-partition, split-boot, fat32, luks reach login.
approaches.lesson: edk2 RISCV_VIRT_CODE.fd boots from pflash without a vars file; -drive default interface on riscv virt is virtio and luks prompts for ubuntu/debian are unchanged.
approaches.title: EFI-only riscv64 platform, edk2 on pflash

approaches.description: Replaces the x86_64-else-arm64 mapping for kernel and grub-efi package names; Debian kernel package derived from it.
approaches.evidence: riscv64 conversions install grub-efi-riscv64-bin and linux-image-riscv64; amd64 debian:13 conversion still installs linux-image-amd64 (log 598137bc...).
approaches.lesson: Same names on amd64; arm64 Debian kernel name becomes correct.
approaches.title: dpkg --print-architecture in Debian/Ubuntu templates

approaches.description: Template selected linux-lts on riscv64 instead of linux-virt.
approaches.evidence: e2e alpine:3.23 single-partition: GRUB loaded kernel lts and initramfs, then no console output for >8 minutes (log bce86e38...). Template change reverted.
approaches.lesson: Alpine riscv64 needs investigation of kernel console/initramfs (maybe earlycon or modules) before claiming support.
approaches.title: Alpine riscv64 with linux-lts

approaches.description: Not used: project topology is a single shared ubuntu-latest host with binfmt.
approaches.evidence: Emulated conversion and TCG boot finished in 9-17 minutes per image locally, within the 60m e2e timeout.
approaches.lesson: Shared-host emulation is sufficient for d2vm e2e.
approaches.title: Separate native riscv64 runner

report.summary: Added linux/riscv64 as an EFI-only d2vm platform after the arm64 precedent (PR 44): platform switches, dpkg-arch based Debian/Ubuntu template packages, riscv64 virt support in pkg/qemu with edk2 on pflash, riscv64 in goreleaser goarch, and riscv64 e2e rows (ubuntu:24.04, debian:13) on the shared ubuntu-latest e2e job. Local emulated e2e for both images passed all grub-efi cases; riscv64 container build and unit tests passed.

findings.title: Default boot size too small for ubuntu:24.04 riscv64
